proposal.reason: Main functional change is in P2P IPC registration/connect lifecycle: transport now supports multi-segment buffer registration/import, segment-aware offsets/sizes, and a feature switch (MULTI_SEGMENT_REGISTER). Added memory-module work is independently substantive because allocation/map/unmap/free helpers now operate across multiple physical segments with stricter granularity/ownership checks. Added network-module work is independently substantive because proxy control-path behavior changed (batched FD query/transfer, per-connection imported-handle tracking, and teardown/deregister cleanup in proxy state).
